title: FUDCourt normalized error envelope
description: The normalized error model every FUDCourt service and route maps its failures into. `code` is the machine-readable category, `message` is the server's own text (display it verbatim — a substituted message hides which layer refused), `request_id` correlates the failure when a correlation id is in scope. Additional keys may appear per category (e.g. `detail`, `errors`, `conflicts`, `preview`, `category`) and must be tolerated additively.

message.description: The server's own error text. Consumers show this verbatim.

request_id.description: Correlation id of the failing request, when in scope.
